name: Rokujou Sayako
source:
She is the principal of the private Seirei Academy and a generous adult woman.
Not only is she passionate about education,
she also has excellent business sense.
While her work is going well,
her relationship with her husband is not going well, which is one of her worries.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc032/character/sayako.html] official site[/url]]
